name: AK11H - Indoor CO2 Monitor & Detector (CO2, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared Sensor
highlights: The AK11T With Infrared CO₂ — Same 98 × 32 × 67 mm shell and 50-per-carton spec. The semiconductor CO₂ element becomes infrared NDIR — the step that turns a trend indicator into a figure you can quote.
Readings That Stay Comparable — Infrared measurement does not age the way a semiconductor element does, so a figure taken next winter can be set against one taken today.
Unaffected by What Else Is in the Air — Alcohol, solvents and cooking vapour move a semiconductor CO₂ reading. They do not move this one.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours — 213 g, USB-C, about three hours to full charge.
The Accuracy Tier of the AK11 Family — Same shell and carton spec as AK11T; the upgrade a distributor offers when a customer asks how accurate the number is.
